summary: Verified real TreeSHAP output on /api/assessment/stop and the new /api/assessments/{id}/pdf endpoint. All 10 pytest cases pass, covering SHAP shape/values, non-hardcoded contributions, TreeSHAP-mentioning explanation, score consistency (final = round(koos*0.4 + movement*0.6, 1)), PDF magic bytes and Content-Type/Content-Disposition, 404 on unknown id, 401 without token, and 404 on cross-workspace access.

minor.issue: assessment_states is still an in-memory per-user dict; running tests with pytest-xdist in parallel on the same clinician account races (start of one worker deactivates the other). Test file works around this via xdist_group + --dist=loadgroup, but the underlying single-process, single-active-assessment-per-user limitation from iteration 1 is unresolved.

Cross-workspace access returns 404 (as spec'd), which correctly hides existence, but the PDF route does not enforce owner_id on the screenings lookup itself — access control is derived only from the patient lookup. Same-workspace clinicians sharing a patient (future multi-tenant scenario) would still fetch each other's reports. Acceptable for current single-owner model.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~382 lines — still fine, but stop_assessment is doing a lot: consider extracting scoring + persistence.
model_explanation swallows all SHAP exceptions into shap_status='unavailable' with no logging — a silent regression would be invisible.

PDF endpoint loads full model+shap on every request via stop path but PDF itself uses stored screening — good. However build_pdf has no size cap and could be slow for many features; fine for current fixed feature set.
assessment_states dict is process-global and not scaled — flagged again from iteration 1.
test_credentials: Used doctor1@jointsense.local / JointSense123! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Also registered ephemeral second clinician for cross-workspace isolation test.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ShapPatient and one screening on the demo clinician account per pytest run (module-scoped fixtures, no delete endpoints available).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real TreeSHAP + PDF endpoint verified end-to-end against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_shap_and_pdf.py uses xdist_group to run serially — invoke with `pytest --dist=loadgroup` or without -n. Sample SHAP contribution example seen: contribution values change per run and do not match old hardcoded (0.24, 0.18, 0.13) triple. PDF sample size ~5-8KB, magic bytes '%PDF-' confirmed.
rca of the issue: N/A — nothing failed. Note: prior iteration 1 issue about shared assessment_states remains and manifested when pytest-xdist parallelised the SHAP+PDF classes on the same user; the test file now pins them to a single xdist worker group.
